title: 价格微涨，费用后可能亏损：本步反馈
source_basis: This packet uses only the accepted assumptions made for this example. It does not show eligibility for execution in a market.
worked: 买后现金9988；卖后加10011−2=10009，得19997。没有另收七日年化收益，不重复加收益或扣内部管理费。
